scope: Hasbro Transformers Studio Series rows (d14ss-*, tfss-*, tfc-*, BBTS wave rows, EE/afmon, legendsverse) + 12 TakaraTomy Showzstore SS rows

sources.upcs: TFW2005 Studio Series stock-photo/UPC thread; retailer image filenames carrying SS number + UPC (Shopify CDN listings)

rules: Row identity = character + film claim; d14ss numbers are sequential placeholders and BBTS-wave dates/prices are placeholders, so they are evidence only when a UPC/image corroborates.
Keeper = curated-transformers > curated > EE > other; merges move aliases + id:<dropId> (keeper msrp/sku/image untouched).
Year fixed to year-only "YYYY" (no invented month/day; tagged date-precision:year) only when outside TFWiki year (±Oct-Dec/Jan-Feb tolerance); month is not sourced.
SKU/UPC/image mismatches are flagged, not changed.
